signal.description: A [..., frames, frame_length] `Tensor`. All dimensions may be unknown, and rank must be at least 2.

frame_step.description: An integer or scalar `Tensor` denoting overlap offsets. Must be less than or equal to `frame_length`.

output.description: A `Tensor` with shape `[..., output_size]` containing the overlap-added frames of `signal`'s inner-most two dimensions.
